cue: Hold still, as a frog does. Only things that move show up.
rows: A frog takes little notice of the parts of its world that stay still, and it can starve beside food that never moves. This view shows only what changes, so hold your phone as still as a frog holds itself.
A cane toad can see a light flicker only about 7 times a second, a ninth as often as a person can. Anything that moves smears into a trail.
Field of view, sharpness and pupil
These parts of the view are guesses.
